services.name: All Cruises
services.desc: Let us help pamper your Mom on Mother’s Day with a cruise down the Mississippi River. This two-hour cruise features a delicious lunch and a live band performance! Complimentary Sweetened Tea, Unsweetened Tea or Water (cash/credit bar for more beverages) Parking is not on site. The closest parking to our boarding location is ACROSS THE STREET from 119 N Riverside Drive Memphis, TN 38103. GPS will bring you to the TN Welcome Center but DO NOT PARK THERE. You will see a “Riverboat Parking Sign” at the entrance of the fenced in lot directly across the street from the Welcome Center. This is a paid parking lot.
